jobs.title: Project Manager - Hazardous Materials
jobs.description:
Project Manager – Hazardous Materials & Asbestos

Lead projects. Build client relationships. Deliver work that matters.

Aztech Services is looking for an experienced Project Manager
to join our growing team. If you're a hands-on leader with a strong background in asbestos and hazardous materials, enjoy building relationships with clients, and know how to deliver projects safely, on time and on budget, we'd love to hear from you.

This is an opportunity to take ownership of multiple projects, lead high-performing teams and play a key role in the continued success of a respected industry leader.

What you'll be doing

Manage multiple hazardous materials and asbestos removal projects from start to finish
Build and maintain strong relationships with clients and key stakeholders
Lead project teams to deliver work safely, on time and within budget
Oversee project costs, financial performance and claim management
Coordinate subcontractors, suppliers and site resources
Conduct client meetings and provide regular project updates
Ensure compliance with all industry legislation, regulations and company procedures
Prepare and review SWMS, site documentation and project reporting
Drive a strong safety culture across every project

What you'll bring

Experience managing projects within the hazardous materials or asbestos industry
Strong knowledge of friable and non-friable asbestos removal, legislation and industry compliance requirements
Proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
Strong client relationship and stakeholder management skills
Experience managing project budgets, cost control and financial outcomes
Excellent leadership skills with the ability to motivate and support site teams
A proactive, solutions-focused approach with a high attention to detail
An uncompromising commitment to safety

Highly regarded

5+ years' Project Management experience
Background in demolition or strip-out projects
Ability to read and interpret construction drawings
Experience managing subcontractors and negotiating with suppliers
Knowledge of older building structures
Strong commercial acumen and contract awareness
Experience preparing SWMS and project documentation
A confident communicator who can lead client meetings and build lasting relationships

The kind of person we're looking for

We're after someone who leads by example. Someone who takes ownership, communicates well, backs their team and delivers on their commitments. You'll be commercially minded, highly organised and committed to maintaining the highest standards of safety and quality.

Why Aztech Services?

At Aztech Services, you'll join a business with a strong reputation for delivering quality outcomes in hazardous materials management. We invest in our people, value initiative and provide the opportunity to work on diverse and rewarding projects where your expertise will make a real difference. Other benefits include:
Introductory and ongoing training
Health-fund discounts
Corporate Health and Fitness Program - Fitness Passport
Banking partnerships – including financial, budgeting and mortgage advice
Discounts at over 100 retailers (including groceries and fuel)
Car servicing, parts and accessories discounts – plus new car discounts

If you're ready to take the lead on challenging projects and build a long-term career with a growing business, we'd love to hear from you.

No agencies please, we’ve got this one covered!

Previous Applicants Need Not Apply.
